content:
Here is the translation of the Sumerian text into English:

1. On the first day, the day was created from the heavens and the earth.
2. On the first night, the night was created from the heavens and the earth.
3. In the first year, the [fates] were determined.
4. The Anunnaki were born.
5. Inanna obtained the august powers.
6. Inanna filled the heavens and the earth.
7. Inanna [...] gave birth.
8. The gods of the provisions, their [...] were bound to the storehouses.
9. The great gods set up the small gods to do work.
10. The gods of the rivers stirred up the dust, they heaped up the soil.
11. The gods of the wind blew, they established the[ir] life.
12. At that time, the broad wisdom of the great gods existed.
13. Enki, the abzu, the pure place, the place where no god's heart could understand.
14. He slept his sleep, and he did not arise.
15. The weeping gods called out, they uttered lamentations.
16. For the sleeping one, his sleeping place did not arise.
17. Namma gave birth to the first-born, the great gods.
18. The weeping of the gods, their son, was brought to him.
19. [...] he lay down with him, and he [...] with him.
20. [...] did not arise.
21. The created gods, their [...] were terrified.
